text: {"name":"rf_get_cal_entry","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Retrieves the RF calibration entry for the current channel/table indices, optionally copies the selected calibration words into the radio context, and returns the calibration code.","subsystem":"rf","var_renames":{"v3":"rf_cal_table_base","v4":"cal_table_index","v5":"rf_cal_table_row","v6":"cal_entry_ptr_pair","v7":"rf_state_table_row","v8":"cal_entry","v10":"result","v11":"copy_words","v12":"cal_step"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":24,"meaning":"rf_context.channel (16-bit current channel, byte-swapped when compared with calibration table)"},{"offset":28,"meaning":"rf_context.state_table_index (index into 1320-byte RF state table)"},{"offset":29,"meaning":"rf_context.cal_table_index (index into 696-byte RF calibration table)"},{"offset":30,"meaning":"rf_context.flags (bit 0 suppresses copying calibration data)"},{"offset":56,"meaning":"rf_context.cal_data destination buffer for copied calibration words"}]}
